articles.title: Show HN: Mnemolith – AI coding memory that goes stale when your code changes

Hi HN, I'm Anish. I built Mnemolith because the AI coding tools I use (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) either forget my project between sessions, or remember things that quietly stopped being true.
